scripts.dev: sh -c 'if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; fi; pnpm --dir apps/web exec react-router dev "$@"' --
scripts.typecheck:packages: pnpm --filter @divelog/domain run typecheck && pnpm --filter @divelog/db run typecheck && pnpm --filter @divelog/server run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:workspace: pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run typecheck:app && pnpm run typecheck:references
scripts.verify:deploy:dry-run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm run cf-types:check && pnpm build && pnpm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.db:rebuild:local: pnpm run db:reset:local && pnpm db:migrate:local && pnpm db:seed:local
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @divelog/web exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm --filter @divelog/web exec wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=seeds/seed.sql
